CONSENT: Do you agree to take part in this assessment?
DEPARTMENT: Which professional department do you work in? Choose the one closest to your work. If none fits, choose "Other". This is used only to group answers.
PS1: In my team, I can express an opinion that differs from others' without fear of negative consequences.
PS2: I can ask questions in my team without worrying about how I will be seen.
PS3: If I make a mistake in my team, it is not held against me.
PS4: I feel safe raising problems and difficult issues in my team.
PS5: I can respectfully disagree with my supervisor without fear of negative consequences.
PS6: It is easy to ask colleagues in my team for help.
IN1: I feel that I belong in my team.
IN2: Everyone in my team has an equal opportunity to take part in discussions.
IN3: Colleagues are treated with respect whatever their cultural or national background.
IN4: Opportunities such as assignments, training and travel are open to everyone in my team.
IN5: Different perspectives are valued in my team, even when they challenge the usual way of working.
IN6: I am treated fairly at work.
CC1: Communicate clearly with colleagues whose language or cultural background differs from yours.
CC2: Adapt how you work when collaborating with colleagues whose working styles differ from yours.
CC3: Work as an equal partner with colleagues across international and national staff, or headquarters and the field.
CC4: Resolve a misunderstanding with a colleague from a different background respectfully.
CC5: Share knowledge and information effectively with colleagues in other teams and duty stations.
LM1: My supervisor treats all team members fairly.
LM2: My supervisor involves team members in decisions that affect their work.
LM3: My supervisor is open to feedback, including criticism.
LM4: My supervisor recognizes everyone's contributions, not only the most visible ones.
LM5: Management explains the reasons for decisions that affect staff.
LM6: My supervisor communicates with team members respectfully.
IB1: Decisions based on assumptions about people's backgrounds rather than on evidence
IB2: Colleagues using stereotypes about a nationality, culture or region
IB3: Colleagues being treated differently because of their nationality, gender, language, age or other background
IB4: Factors other than merit affecting who is recruited or promoted
IB5: Similar contributions being recognized differently depending on who made them
IB6: Differences in power (for example between headquarters and the field, international and national staff, or senior and junior staff) deciding whose views count
OS1: I have access to training on diversity, inclusion and bias.
OS2: I know how to report discrimination or unfair treatment in my organization.
OS3: When discrimination or unfair treatment is reported, my organization takes appropriate action.
OS4: Senior management actively supports diversity and inclusion.
OS5: I have opportunities for professional development in my organization.
